title: refactor(plugin-dashboard, plugin-list)!: retire eight zero-consumer entry exports
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDadpmv8nuw2HbLjjF77YBK)_

Part of #25921. The umbrella stays open; this is one barrel batch of it (claim 6660204183, amended 6660498263, seat `domain:ui#6`).

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` 的包入口不再导出 5 个名字(配置面板的默认英文表与翻译钩子、已退役节点类型的墓碑组件及其上报/重置函数),`@object-ui/plugin-list` 不再导出 3 个名字(视图切换下拉、标签栏下拉、条件格式包装函数)。模块本身全部保留。
- 为什么改:这 8 个名字在仓内(包外)与 hotcrm 均零引用,只是让公开面看起来比实际大;本卡逐包清理无人使用的 barrel 导出。
- 风险与回滚:对外是 breaking 收窄,只影响直接从包入口 import 这些名字的外部宿主;控制台与所有 `@object-ui/*` 包不受影响,退役节点仍按名拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`(两段导出改写)、`.changeset/25921-plugin-dashboard-zero-consumer-exports.md`(迁移说明)、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -w -e ViewSwitcherDropdown -e TabBarSelect -e evaluateConditionalFormatting -e useConfigPanelTranslation -e RetiredDashboardNodeTombstone -- ':!ui/packages/plugin-list' ':!ui/packages/plugin-dashboard' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 应只命中两份新 changeset。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/index.tsx`: the entry stops exporting `CONFIG_PANEL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, `useConfigPanelTranslation`, `RetiredDashboardNodeTombstone`, `reportRetiredDashboardNodeType` and `resetRetiredDashboardNodeTypeReports`. `ConfigPanelTranslate` (the README teaches it) and `RETIRED_DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES` stay. The two comments that justified the old exports are rewritten: the defaults-vs-pack mirror gate (`defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`) discovers every defaults table from source through `scanDefaultsTables`, so it needs no import from this entry.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/dashboardBareKeyOwnership.test.tsx`: imports `RetiredDashboardNodeTombstone` and `resetRetiredDashboardNodeTypeReports` from `../retired-node-types` instead of `../index`. Same objects, so the identity comparison is unchanged; the entry import still performs the registrations.
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx`: the entry stops exporting `ViewSwitcherDropdown`, `TabBarSelect` and `evaluateConditionalFormatting`.
- Two new changesets, `.changeset/25921-plugin-dashboard-zero-consumer-exports.md` and `.changeset/25921-plugin-list-zero-consumer-exports.md`: patch level, `!` title, BREAKING paragraph, one FROM/TO line per retired name, ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming every operand.
- No module file is deleted. Every retired name keeps an in-package reader (`ListView` renders `ViewSwitcherDropdown`; the config panels use the hook; `index.tsx` registers the tombstone; the rest are read by their own tests).

## Tests

Census on `origin/main` fa9c0aa2 with the #28385 / #29388 method: the entry export list from the TypeScript checker; per name `git grep -o -w -F` over the whole tree minus the package directory, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, lockfiles and `.changeset/**`; the package README, SKILL.md and demo; keep rule 3 (a name a kept export's declared signature reaches, walked with the checker); hotcrm `6961ab1` `git grep -l -w -F`.

| Package | Name | Hits outside the package | hotcrm | Verdict |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| plugin-dashboard | `CONFIG_PANEL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-dashboard | `useConfigPanelTranslation` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-dashboard | `RetiredDashboardNodeTombstone` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-dashboard | `reportRetiredDashboardNodeType` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-dashboard | `resetRetiredDashboardNodeTypeReports` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-dashboard | `ConfigPanelTranslate` | 0 | | kept: README "TypeScript Support" teaches it |
| plugin-dashboard | `WidgetDatasetCatalogEntry`, `WidgetDatasetDimension`, `WidgetDatasetMeasure` | 0 | | kept: rule 3, via `WidgetConfigPanelProps` |
| plugin-dashboard | `DashboardMetricNodeSchema` | 0 | | kept: its entry line is what loads `widgetDispatch`'s `CustomNodeRegistry` augmentation into consumers' programs |
| plugin-list | `ViewSwitcherDropdown` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-list | `TabBarSelect` | 0 | 0 | retired |
| plugin-list | `evaluateConditionalFormatting` | 0 | 0 | retired |

| controls | `DashboardRenderer` 76, `RETIRED_DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES` 2, `ViewSwitcher` 29, `TabBar` 11, `normalizeFilterCondition` 9, `ListView` 621; hotcrm `ListView` 7 | | | |

Readings at head 14d4c822:

- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` with their `^build` closure: 77 of 77 tasks successful (lock VERDICT command-exit 0, 8m39s).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/plugin-list/`: Test Files 391 passed (391); Tests 3741 passed, 6 skipped (3747); VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`: a temporary probe in app-shell importing all eight retired names plus four kept controls gave exactly eight errors, one per retired name (`TS2305` / `TS2724 … has no exported member`), while `RETIRED_DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES`, `DashboardRenderer`, `TabBar` and `ViewSwitcher` resolved. Probe deleted; `git status` clean.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:readme-exports`: `0 fabricated, 0 stale omission(s)`; exit 1 only on the known prerequisite (`packages/cli` dist unbuilt, its two self-imports unjudged).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files.
- No ablation: export lines removed, no tested behaviour changed.

## Acceptance notes

- `TabBarSelect` and `evaluateConditionalFormatting` now have no reader in the package's non-test code either: only their own tests import them from the module. `evaluateConditionalFormatting` is a one-line wrapper over `@object-ui/core`'s `resolveConditionalFormatting`. Retiring the bodies (and their tests) is a later pass on this card, not filed separately.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` says the package's "whole type export surface is `WidgetConfigPanelProps`, `ConfigPanelTranslate` and the three `WidgetDataset*` catalog types"; `DashboardMetricNodeSchema` has been on the entry since an earlier release, so that sentence was already incomplete before this PR. Untouched here (README not on the claim's surface).
- Branch name is the platform-assigned `claude/project-thread-h719zv`, not `claude/issue-25921-*`.
- A contract-review-tier review is owed before the queue (narrowing batch); the seat runs it.

## Verification

Derived gates, dogfood battery and the final-head readings are in the os-dev-report comment on #25921; CI check-runs on this PR are the record for every family CI runs.
